title: Ordinal numbers
examples: Teacher, what comes after the second?
Can you show me the fourth one in the line?

explain.say: Look at these toys. We are going to put them in order. The first toy is the red car. Say first.
Next, the second toy is the blue ball. This is the second one in line. Say second.
The third toy is the yellow block. This shows us the third position. Say third.
If we line up friends, we say first, second, and third to know the order. For example, you are in the second position.

faq.q: What is the difference between counting and ordinal numbers?
faq.a: Counting tells you how many things there are. Ordinal numbers tell you the position of something in a line.
asks: How is counting different from order?
Do I count or say where it is?

faq.q: If there are ten friends, what is the tenth one?
faq.a: The tenth one means it is the last person in that group of ten. It shows the final spot.
asks: What does the tenth spot mean?
How do I know the last position?

faq.q: Do I have to say the number word every time?
faq.a: It is best to say the word and point to the position. This helps you remember the order correctly.
asks: Can I just point to the spot?
Is it okay to just point?

faq.q: If I skip a number, do I still use the next ordinal number?
faq.a: No, you must say the correct number in order. If you skip one, you are saying the wrong position.
asks: If I miss a number, what do I say?
Should I count up or skip?

faq.q: What is the biggest ordinal number we learn?
faq.a: We learn numbers up to twenty for positions. You can keep counting higher as you get older.
asks: How high do we count to?
What is the biggest order number?

facts: Ordinal numbers tell the position of something.
The first position is called first.
The second position is called second.
The third position is called third.

quiz.say: In a line of three children, who is standing in the middle?
quiz.why: The middle position when there are three items is always the second one.

wrong.0: This is the very end of the line, not the middle.
wrong.1: There are only three children, so the fourth spot does not exist.
wrong.3: This is the beginning of the line, not the middle.

quiz.say: If you color the fifth flower in a row, what number are you pointing to?
quiz.why: The word fifth tells you exactly which spot you need to color.

wrong.1: Five is a number we count, but fifth tells the position.
wrong.2: The word form is usually expected when talking about order.
wrong.3: This is the spot right before the fifth one.

quiz.say: Which word correctly shows the spot after the second spot?
quiz.why: After the second position comes the third position in counting order.

wrong.0: This word means the same spot, not the next one.
wrong.2: This is not a word we use to show position.
wrong.3: Four is the number, but we need the word for the position.
